summary: Iteration 17 — Rider Backend Platform comprehensive testing. All 38 tests pass covering: admin rider CRUD, rider auth (login/refresh/logout/rotation), profile, status, push token, job current/history, stats, assignment via admin and delivery router, soft delete, role isolation (customer JWT rejected), and regression (shopify home + webhook). One minor backend behavior noted: email uniqueness check in create_rider does not exclude soft-deleted riders.

minor.issue: Email uniqueness check (service.py line 263) queries without `isDeleted: False` filter — a soft-deleted rider email cannot be re-used to create a new rider account (returns 409). This may be intentional for audit reasons but should be documented.

action_items: Clarify/document whether soft-deleted rider emails should be re-usable. Currently they cannot be (create returns 409). Consider adding `isDeleted: False` to the uniqueness check if re-use is desired.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin endpoints are intentionally unauthenticated (documented TODO). Must be protected before production.
Delivery job status values are lowercase (e.g. 'assigned', 'pending_assignment') — consistent with DeliveryJobStatus enum. Documentation and test assertions should match lowercase.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_ rider accounts and PENDING_ASSIGNMENT delivery jobs via webhook for testing. All cleaned up (riders soft-deleted by test suite).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 38 rider backend tests pass. Delivery job statuses are lowercase (pending_assignment, assigned, etc.). Email is stored lowercase. Assignment tests require PENDING_ASSIGNMENT jobs — create them via POST /api/webhooks/shopify before running. The test file test_rider_backend_iteration17.py uses unique timestamped emails per run for clean state.
